Carla: Hey team — pushed an initial change (branch: feat/carla/model-routing-logs) to add more logging around smart routing. Quick q: what's our branch naming standard and review flow? Also hitting pre-commit failure locally, any quick fixes?

Jun: Welcome! Branch naming: feat/<your-github>/<short-desc> or fix/<...>. Example: feat/carla/model-routing-logs. Keep it concise (aim for <= 50 chars after your name).

Sam: We typically request 2 reviewers for runtime changes: one tech lead and one platform reviewer. Use the reviewers field on the PR, and add the label `review/request`.

Mia: Docs here: https://redwood.internal/devex/branches-and-prs (see "PR checklist"). Also follow the commit message template — subject line + one-sentence body + optional details.

Devon: For the pre-commit, run:
```
pre-commit run --all-files
```
If it's black/ruff hooks, `python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt` then re-run. If the commit-msg hook is missing: `pre-commit install --hook-type commit-msg`.

Carla: thanks — `pre-commit run` fixed the lint; re-pushed. CI kicked off but shows one flaky test failing in integration-model-routing.

ci-bot: CI started for carla/feat/model-routing-logs — build 4523 — status: running

Jun: For flaky tests, add the `flake/investigate` label and ping Devon — I can help repro locally. We squash-merge small fixes; for bigger features keep separate commits and use a merge commit.

Sam: Also FYI: CODEOWNERS for /runtime/* will auto-request @Jun and @Devon, so reviewers should appear automatically. If you touch docs, add @Mia as well.

Carla: Where's best to ask about review backlog if it's slow? I don't want to sit blocked.

Mia: Ping `#devex` or DM Sam/Mia; we triage stale review requests. For urgent unblocks, add `review/priority` label and mention the reviewer in the PR.

Carla: Awesome, thanks everyone! I'll add the labels and ping if flaky persists :thumbsup:

Sam: Nice — welcome aboard :wave:
